ourCauses.title: Seeds of Change in Action
ourCauses.description: Every child deserves the opportunity to learn, grow, and build a brighter future. Explore the causes that drive our mission.

causes.title: Digital Literacy for All
causes.description: Bridging the digital divide by helping children develop essential computer skills and access modern learning resources.
causes.imageAlt: Children learning digital skills on computers

causes.title: STEAM Workshops in Rural Areas
causes.description: Inspiring young minds through hands-on science, technology, engineering, arts, and mathematics activities.
causes.imageAlt: Students participating in a hands-on science workshop

causes.title: The Mobile Library Initiative
causes.description: Bringing books, storytelling, and educational resources to children in underserved communities.
causes.imageAlt: Children exploring books at a community library

causes.title: Art & Gardening for Empowerment
causes.description: Encouraging creativity, teamwork, environmental awareness, and confidence through art and gardening.
causes.imageAlt: Children planting seedlings together in a garden

causes.title: School Supplies for Every Child
causes.description: Providing notebooks, stationery, school bags, and essential learning materials to children who need them.
causes.imageAlt: School bags and stationery prepared for students

causes.title: Girls' Education & Opportunity
causes.description: Supporting girls with learning resources, mentoring, and opportunities to pursue their educational goals.
causes.imageAlt: Girls studying together in a supportive classroom

bottomCta.title: Be a Part of the Story
bottomCta.description: Your support can open doors to education, inspire young minds, and help create lasting change in communities.

items.name: Roo Jackson
items.quote: Volunteering with this team changed how I see my own community. They listen to families, plan with them, and show up every week. I am proud to be part of it.

items.name: Anita Sharma
items.quote: My daughter now goes to class every day and comes home excited to share what she learned. The teachers are patient and the learning center feels like a second home.

items.name: Daniel Okafor
items.quote: I donate every month because the yearly report shows exactly where the money goes. It is rare to see an organization this open and this effective.
